en: This is a black-and-white postcard featuring three photographic views of a small rural village. The top image shows a church with a distinctive tower surrounded by trees and several houses. The middle image shows a large manor-like building by a pond, with additional smaller buildings and abundant greenery. The bottom image provides a panoramic view of the village, with scattered houses, trees, and open fields. The overall scene is peaceful and pastoral.
